meta.datum: WGS84 positions; heights above the EGM2008 geoid (GLO-30) / EGM96 (SRTM3); published heights as stated per peak
meta.bearing: true geodesic forward azimuth from the viewpoint, degrees clockwise from true north (Vincenty, WGS84)
meta.elevation: apparent elevation of the summit above the eye's horizontal, degrees, on a sphere of effective radius 6371008.8 / (1 - 0.13) m (earth curvature plus standard terrestrial refraction k = 0.13); elevationFlatDeg ignores both
meta.visible: ray-marched over GLO-30 from 50 m to 300 m short of the summit, against the published summit height; marginal = the call flips with SRTM3, or with terrain nearer than 300 m ignored, or the margin is under 0.5 deg
meta.aboveForegroundDeg: summit elevation minus the highest terrain in front of the col below the summit (how much of the peak shows)
meta.horizon: skyline elevation angle (deg, curvature + refraction) for bearings 0..359 at 1 deg, GLO-30, terrain nearer than 50 m ignored (DSM clutter); the near part (< 2 km) is uncertain to several degrees, see horizonDetail.srtm3ElevationDeg and farElevationDeg (terrain beyond 2 km only)
meta.test: pass if |bearing - truth| <= 1 and |elevation - truth| <= 1 deg for every visible, non-marginal peak; in a world scaled by s about a point, convert the viewpoint with fromReal() and compare angles directly
